name: Wonder Wheel
source:
You have been invited by two of your friends to take a ride on a Ferris wheel on the 4th of July. Your friends have been dating for about a year. How have they been doing lately? And how are you doing?

[Edited from [url=https://lemonpoppyseedgames.itch.io/wonder-wheel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受两位朋友的邀请，于7月4日乘坐摩天轮。你的朋友已经约会大约一年了。他们最近过得怎么样？你怎么样？

[编辑自[url=https://lemonpoppyseedgames.itch.io/wonder-wheel]itch.io[/url]]
